nodes.name: Every Monday 7:30 AM
nodes.notes:
FLOW: Schedule → Get Credentials → Refresh Baseline → Measure Experiments → Launch New Experiment → Get Insights → Build Report → Email Report

Fires once per week every Monday at 7:30 AM, kicking off the full growth agent cycle: measure last week's experiments, launch a new one, and email a summary report.

nodes.name: Get Credentials
nodes.notes: Fetches runtime environment variables (e.g. REPORT_EMAIL_TO) from the backend. Required because n8n environment variables are not available on this instance. The Email Growth Report node reads REPORT_EMAIL_TO from this node's output.

nodes.name: Refresh Baseline Conv Rate
nodes.notes: Recalculates and stores the rolling 7-day baseline conversion rate in Postgres. Must run before measuring experiments so comparisons use a fresh denominator. Returns baseline_conv_rate used in the report.

nodes.name: Measure Previous Experiments
nodes.notes: Scores all experiments whose measure_at date has passed. For each experiment: computes cohort conversion rate vs. baseline, marks winner/loss, records learnings in Postgres. Returns results[] array (winner flag, conversion rate, orders won, cohort size, learnings text).

nodes.name: Design + Launch New Experiment
nodes.notes: Calls the Claude-backed growth agent on the backend. Reads past experiment learnings, picks a high-leverage hypothesis, selects a cohort of contacts, assigns them a variant treatment (message/offer/channel), and writes the new experiment row to Postgres. Returns the new experiment details for the report.

nodes.name: Get Growth Insights
nodes.notes: Reads all completed experiments and returns a distilled insights_summary string — a synthesized paragraph of what has and has not worked across all experiments to date. Used as the closing section of the weekly report.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Report
nodes.notes: Assembles all upstream data into a styled HTML email. Reads from: Refresh Baseline Conv Rate (baseline_conv_rate), Measure Previous Experiments (results[]), Design + Launch New Experiment (new experiment details), Get Growth Insights (insights_summary). Outputs body_html and subject.

nodes.name: Email Growth Report
nodes.notes: POSTs the HTML report to /api/internal/send-email (config.py credential proxy), which sends directly via SMTP using SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASSWORD env vars. Requires X-Admin-Secret header (DW Admin Secret credential).
